institutional-names-slower.title: Mentioning specific institutional or brand names predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
institutional-names-slower.body: Pitches that reference specific financial institutions or brands tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-gratitude-faster.title: Explicit expressions of gratitude to lenders accelerate funding for female borrowers.
female-gratitude-faster.body: Pitches from women that include specific thank you messages to the lender community tend to fund faster.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.body: Pitches that highlight social or educational benefits for children tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-education-level-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly mention their education level fund more slowly.
female-education-level-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify the borrower's or their children's education level tend to predict slower funding speed.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-logistical-detail-slower.body: Female borrowers who include specific daily logistics like walking distances may fund more slowly.

male-repeat-borrower-faster.body: Mentioning status as a repeat borrower may accelerate funding for male borrowers.

male-geographic-specificity-slower.body: Male borrowers who mention specific geographic locations may fund more slowly.

male-length-slower.body: Longer pitch text may predict slower funding for male borrowers.

female-cliche-family-slower.body: Female borrowers using clichéd phrases about family futures may fund more slowly.

female-local-currency-slower.body: Female borrowers who include the loan amount in local currency may fund more slowly.

female-hardship-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific personal hardships like widowhood or refugee status may fund faster.

female-status-mention-slower.body: Mentioning marital status or children without specifying benefits may slow funding for women.

female-existing-business-faster.title: Female borrowers describing an existing business may fund faster than those describing starting a new one.
female-existing-business-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-age-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age may fund more slowly.
female-age-mention-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-length-slower.title: Lengthier pitches may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-length-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

living-conditions-interaction.title: Mentioning home or living condition improvements accelerates funding for women but slows it for men.
living-conditions-interaction.retrospective: Retired to make room for new claim regarding female history/duration effects.

female-diversification-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention diversifying their income or product range may fund faster.
female-diversification-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-marital-status-slower.title: Explicitly stating marital status may predict slower funding for female borrowers.
female-marital-status-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

male-daily-routine-faster.title: Detailed daily routines may accelerate funding for male borrowers.
male-daily-routine-faster.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

male-family-roles-slower.title: Mentioning family members and their roles may predict slower funding for male borrowers.
male-family-roles-slower.retrospective: Stale puzzle dropped to make room for new observations.

female-history-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention business duration or loan history fund more slowly.
female-history-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that duration accelerates funding for women, while institutional loan history slows it.

female-product-lists-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide exhaustive lists of specific products may fund more slowly.
female-product-lists-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that listing specific inventory items accelerates funding for women.
